name: עַי
summary: Chiefly the town east of Bethel: Abram pitched his tent between the two, and Joshua sent men from Jericho to it. Jeremiah also names an Ai in Ammon. The name may be the noun עִי “heap of ruins”, but this is not shown.

evidence.note: Bethel is west of the tent and Ai is east of it.
Joshua sends men from Jericho to Ai, which the verse locates east of Bethel.
Abram returns to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had stood.
“Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste”: an Ai in Ammon.

note: Moved from the former word entry `3ay`. The old root key עי recorded the consonants of the place name. Its proposed derivation from עִי, “heap of ruins” (a word of 3wh, root עוה), is uncertain, so the name is left unassigned. Ai@Jer.49.3 is added as a second bearer of the spelling.
